GT IPTV Player Pro v1.4.0 — Stable Release

Highlights:
- Selectable backup and restore dashboards with section sizes, destination paths, archive verification and safety backups.
- Improved backup restoration on receivers with different disk and mount layouts; existing 1.3.0 user-data backups remain supported.
- Multi-day EPG guide with programme details and continuing live preview, where provided by the source.
- Short 0 recalls the previous Live TV channel across Xtream, M3U and Stalker sources; hold 0 restarts the current live stream.
- Compact redesigned information bar with corrected text rendering, progress, remaining time, weather and receiver network rate.
- Shared weather preparation at plugin startup, including playback opened through YouTube.
- Faster page transitions, RAM-aware UHD image caching, favourites loading and progressive movie/series details.
- Download queues continue after an individual connection/server failure. Account testing, portal text import and expiry handling have been improved.
- OpenATV navigation/seeking fixes, identified OpenPLi compatibility fixes, metadata language preference and original/default YouTube audio selection.
- All new interface text is available in the existing 43 device languages.

The network indicator samples incoming receiver-interface traffic once per second while the information bar is visible. It includes other receiver downloads and is not a per-stream bitrate or internet speed test.

Package:
- Plugin version: 1.4.0
- Package version: 1.4.0-r0
- Architecture: all
- Python: 3.9 or newer
- File: enigma2-plugin-extensions-gtiptvplayerpro_1.4.0-r0_all.ipk
